entities.summary: The Rurality Movement, formerly Hunting, Fishing, Nature and Traditions, is an agrarianist political party in France which aims to defend the traditional values of rural France. Its leader is Eddie Puyjalon. The party states it is neither right nor left but represents rural people on the whole in their diversity.
